title: 500 to 100 series adapter.
title_em: Your 100 series modules in any 500 rack.
lead: The K7 adapter lets Rodec 100 series modules run in any 500 series housing, so it is mainly meant for third-party 500 racks. It takes one stereo slot and holds up to 22HP of modules, such as the M-108, M-102 and M-104 shown here (6 + 6 + 10HP).

panels.heading: Inside the adapter
panels.alt: The K7 adapter board between its two 500 series slot positions

items.name: To the first module
items.label: TO FIRST MINI MOD
items.text: Ribbon cable to the first 100 series module. The audio from the rack arrives here unbalanced.

items.name: Return from the last module
items.label: RETURN FROM LAST
items.text: Ribbon cable back from the last module in the chain. The adapter balances it again for the rack.

items.name: Stereo slot
items.label: LEFT SLOT · RIGHT SLOT
items.text: The adapter takes two positions of the 500 series rack: one stereo slot.
